note: The outlines (GeoJSON Polygon / MultiPolygon, [lon, lat]) of 72 quarters and squares of the layer of places, put into site/data/places.json by hand on 2026-11-24 (Gemini) and kept here so that a rebuild does not lose them; tools/apply_places_edits.py gives an outline to an item that lacks one. Source: geometry of OpenStreetMap objects (ODbL): a sample of 6 ways and relations was compared with OpenStreetMap by Nominatim (98-100 % of the vertices equal); the 9 outlines of the item nodes (Chugureti, Isani, Krtsanisi, Mtatsminda, Saburtalo, Sololaki, Vake, Vera, Didube) have no OSM object of their own and their origin is NOT recorded.
